ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Émilie du Châtelet, a French mathematician and physicist, was born in Paris in 1706. During her childhood, with her father's support, she was able to get mathematical and scientific education that most women of her time did not receive. In 1737, she submitted her paper on the nature of fire to a contest sponsored by the French Academy of Sciences, and it was published a year later. In her book, Institutions de Physique, Émilie du Châtelet explained the ideas of space and time in a way that is closer to what we understand in modern relativity than what was common during her time. Her most significant achievement was translating Isaac Newton's Principia into French near the end of her life. Émilie du Châtelet's work was not recognized in her time, but she is now remembered as a symbol of the Enlightenment and the struggle for women's participation in science.

det.korean: recognize → recognized: be동사 뒤 수동태 과거분사
det.analysis: 'Her work was not __________ (recognize) in her time'에서 be동사(was) 뒤 수동태를 이루는 과거분사가 필요. recognize → recognized. 'was not recognized' = 인정받지 못했다 (수동)

questions.passage: Émilie du Châtelet, a French mathematician and physicist, was born in Paris in 1706. During her childhood, with her __________, she was able to get mathematical and scientific education that most women of her time did not receive. In 1737, she submitted her paper on the nature of fire to a contest sponsored by the French Academy of Sciences, and it was published a year later. In her book, Institutions de Physique, Émilie du Châtelet explained the ideas of space and time in a way that is closer to what we understand in modern relativity than what was common during her time. Her most significant achievement was translating Isaac Newton's Principia into French near the end of her life. Émilie du Châtelet's work was not recognized in her time, but she is now remembered as a symbol of the Enlightenment and the struggle for women's participation in science.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: father's support=아버지의 지원 — 교육을 받을 수 있었던 배경
det.analysis:
✅ ① father's support: '어린 시절 __________로, 그녀는 당대 대부분 여성이 받지 못한 교육을 받을 수 있었다'에서 교육을 가능하게 한 배경으로 '아버지의 지원(father's support)'이 적절 ←정답
❌ ② own money: '자신의 돈'은 본문 근거 없음
❌ ③ teacher's warning: '교사의 경고'는 모순
❌ ④ brother's help: '형제의 도움'은 근거 없음
det.tip: with her father's support = 아버지의 지원으로

det.korean: not recognized=인정받지 못한 — 당대에는 인정받지 못했으나 지금은 기억됨
det.analysis:
✅ ② not recognized: '그녀의 업적은 당대에 __________였지만, 이제는 계몽주의의 상징으로 기억된다'에서 but(그러나)과 대조되어 '인정받지 못한(not recognized)'이 적절 ←정답
❌ ① widely celebrated: '널리 기려진'은 but 이하와 대조가 성립하지 않음
❌ ③ strictly banned: '엄격히 금지된'은 과도함
❌ ④ highly profitable: '매우 수익성 있는'은 무관
det.tip: work was not recognized in her time = 당대에는 인정받지 못했다
